description: Standing on a shulker box facing up and opening it (looking down at it): its lid lifts the player; the box is closed (the client closes its screen) and the player drops back onto it. Then opening a shulker box facing east from its east side: its lid pushes the player east; closed again.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
